h: Shabbos Chazon and the Heart Made Whole

p: For it is stated in the holy Zohar
there is the radiance of Atika Kadisha.
is the aspect of the Field of Apples;
וְהוּא יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
which is the union of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah;
the upper hei of the Name Havayah.
by the name of the middah of Atika,
which is the aspect of Keser,
alluded to by the tip of the yud,
from the aspect of Atika Kadisha,
since it is the intellect hidden
and the negation of all comprehension
However, all this can be understood
according to what is stated in the holy Zohar
the radiance of Atika Kadisha shone forth, etc.,
and when the radiance of the alef joined
That is: the aspect of Keser
for it is the first utterance,
However, at a time of favor
illumination flows from within the darkness
which are the mind and the heart.
And this is "bored through the darkness
that is, to Chochmah and Binah,
which are called by the names
And through this the illumination spreads
and this is "until they reached the zayin."
And with this, both are correct together:
the words of the holy Zohar
the illumination of Atika Kadisha flows
And with this are also understood
the words of the Arizal, of blessed memory:
that is, illumination flows into the mind.
And it is called "the great Kiddush,"
the abundance of holiness from above,
in the manner of "A person sanctifies himself
that is, with the Kiddush of the night,
which is the arousal from below,
מְקַדְּשִׁין אוֹתוֹ הַרְבֵּה מִלְמַעְלָה (יוֹמָא לט, א)
that is, with the Kiddush of the day.
And holiness denotes separation and distinction;
כִּי עַל יְדֵי הֶאָרַת הַחָכְמָה בַּמּוֹחַ
for through the illumination of Chochmah in the mind
all the desires and cravings of this world.
that is, when there flows from it
"And wine gladdens the heart of man,"
which alludes to the aspect of
and "joy for the upright of heart" (Tehillim 97:11);
for when illumination flows into the heart,
that is at his left is straightened,
And that is the aspect of the upper Shabbos,
which is the aspect of the upper hei,
which is the aspect of higher fear,
which has already been fixed in him, in the heart,
Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, came
after he had already been perfected in everything.
After the test of the Akeidah
for then there was already perfected in him
and there were straightened in him
all the powers of the heart.
is only by way of conquering the yetzer
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Avos 4:1):
is after there has already been straightened in the heart
that it be transformed into good.
וְעִנְיַן אָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרָכוֹת נט, א)
And the matter of our Sages' saying (Berachos 59a):
to straighten the crookedness of the heart,
'And God has made it so that they should fear before Him'"
from the aspect of fear of God,
only that it comes from above,
of the thunder and the noise,
from this the powers of the soul are nullified,
and the crookedness of the heart is straightened
until he reaches the level of
Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
from this branches out joy in the heart,
כִּי נָכוֹן לִבּוֹ בָּטוּחַ (תְּהִלִּים קיב, ז)
that all the powers of the heart within
are perfected and straightened to good.

on "Yet all this is worth nothing to me" (Esther 5:13):
that all the treasures of that wicked one
for it was clear before his eyes,
therefore the word "this" is used of it,
as one who points with a finger.
And about this we now say:
And all the more on this Shabbos,
if on account of the beginning of the haftarah
the refinement of the three upper ones,
the aspect of Chochmah, Binah, Daas;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה בָּאִים אַחַר כָּךְ
and through this one comes afterward
which allude to the refinement of the seven middos
in order from above to below,
alludes to the appearance of the root,
which is the word of Hashem
while it has not yet been drawn down
to have a hold among the lower ones.
And after this one comes to "Shim'u":
which is in the aspect of Chochmah,
what one receives from the root,
for this is the aspect of Chochmah:
And after this one comes to the aspect of "Chazon,"
which is the revelation of seeing
in the understanding of the heart:
that is, the aspect of the "first,"
from the root and the source;
and as our Sages, of blessed memory, said:
and this is the first utterance,
"Have you not from now on called to Me:
My Father, You are the guide of my youth?"
that is, the drawing down of the aspect of Chochmah,
from a place higher than oneself,
And in the haftarah "The vision of Yeshayahu"
"Come now, let us reason together, says Hashem;
if your sins be like scarlet,
they shall become white as snow";
שֶׁהָיָה הַלָּשׁוֹן שֶׁל זְהוֹרִית מַלְבִּין (יוֹמָא סז, א)
when the strip of scarlet wool would turn white (Yoma 67a),
through the appearance of Binah in the heart,
to turn the willful sins into merits
from the depths of the heart.
to the revelation of the salvation in actuality
"For the matter is very near to you,
in your mouth and in your heart, to do it."
That is: when the word of Hashem comes,
that is, through a person's effort
do not forsake the work of Your hands."
And therefore it does not say
as it is written "in your mouth and in your heart";
for the completion of the deed
And therefore the Shabbos is called "Chazon,"
the purpose of the salvation is completed.

p: Now he said in this rebuke
until "Come now, let us reason together," etc.,
as Rashi, of blessed memory, explained.
from the side of man, in order:
וְאַחַר כָּךְ לִהְיוֹת וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב (תְּהִלִּים לד, טו)
also in thought and in deed.
is in thought, in the heart;
and "judge the orphan, plead for the widow"
that from now on he will have the power
"Fortunate are those whose way is perfect,
who walk in the Torah of Hashem."
For as long as one has not been purified
of the filth of the soul,
he is entangled in the thickets of sins,
to move himself and to walk.
כִּי כְּבָר בָּא עַל יְדֵי מַעֲשָׂיו
for he has already come through his deeds
through which willful sins become like merits (Yoma 86b).
is the aspect of lower teshuvah,
by a thought in the mind alone,
that willful sins become like unintentional ones.
And therefore one who betroths a woman
on condition that he is completely righteous,
even if he is completely wicked,
for perhaps he had thoughts of teshuvah in his mind
And also "though they be red like crimson"
like the crimson worm that dyes others
has the power to be transformed
which is a level below snow,
who heard from behind the Curtain
because "one is not given the opportunity"
there was in this an arousal
and his teshuvah would also have been effective,
as is stated in the holy Shelah.
who sinned and caused others to sin
תְּפָסוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּבִגְדוֹ (סַנְהֶדְרִין קב, א)
HaKadosh Baruch Hu seized him by his garment (Sanhedrin 102a)
that the son of Yishai would be at the head,
so that this would be the cause
of "one is not given the opportunity."
in seizing him by his garment
was so that he would strengthen himself
because he was a precious soul;
and then there would have been transformed for him
all the willful sins into merits,

— “The Gemara cites a related story: The Sages taught: There was once an incident involving Aḥer, who was riding on a horse on Shabbat, and Rabbi Meir was walking behind him to learn Torah from him. After a while, Aḥer …”
